description: A dim palace corridor with a carved wooden door ajar. A man in a dark bicorne-style uniform with red facings and white breeches holds a candle aloft. Several officers in dark uniforms, bicorne hats with white plumes and epaulettes, with swords drawn, crowd toward the doorway. One officer in the foreground stands with his back turned. Gilt-edged paintings hang on the walls and a vaulted hall recedes into shadow. No visible text, frame or violence.
